conclusion: No evidence that generic preseason prediction improves by weighting prior-season offense and defense differently. Equal weighting was the best tested specification; unequal weights worsened MAE.
productionRule: Do not manually resolve Week 1 disagreements by broadly favoring offense over defense or vice versa. Remaining corrections must come from current-personnel/coaching state, QB delta, availability, or richer opponent-adjusted efficiency reconstruction rather than generic side-of-ball weighting.
